subject: Add grpc coordinator threads CPU time metric to INFO command (#674)
reason: The change only does anything when the module is loaded with the --use-coordinator module argument: the ThreadGroupCPUMonitor is created in ValkeySearch::Startup only under GetUseCoordinator(), and the new INFO field search_coordinator_threads_cpu_time_sec is VisibleIf(UsingCoordinator()), so its Computed callback (the only entry into the new /proc-reading monitor code) never runs otherwise. use-coordinator is a Hidden config: it is never registered with Valkey, so it cannot be set with CONFIG SET or a valkey.conf directive, only as a module load argument. The fuzzer loads modules by bare path
